name: cloud-account
description: Diego's Cloud Account — the Account page (Profile, Connect sign-in lines, Fleet cockpit, Infos, Drift, business card) as its own APK (#867). Hosts libs:account, the same code SuperApp's Configs > Account used to embed. Owns the imported configs, the profile and the S/R/L account files; SuperApp copies them over once and reads through to them while this app is installed.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: A_A0-Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A_A0-Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph. settings.gradle iterates this list. Every lib is shared BY REFERENCE from ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs, the same directories cloud-superapp builds, so the account code exists once.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.

tests._doc: Read by 1_cicd/dist/scripts/cloud-android-test-engine.sh, which the ship workflow runs before it builds.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl). The four sections are libs:account's tabs (ids and order = aa_cloud-superapp/build.json::ui.profile.tabs); the island selects the tab ProfileFragment shows and ProfileFragment's own strip is hidden (ProfileFragment.ARG_EXTERNAL_STRIP).
ui._doc_pages: #873/#874 the pages Cloud Account adds under the four sections (the first page of a section is the section's own tab, so selecting a section still opens what it always did): Connections (every endpoint, token and profile the vault holds, with the encrypted bundle export/import and the take-in from SuperApp), Data (profile, identities, S/R/L), Configs (every app's declared settings by store), Secrets (per-app grants, revocable), Fleet Setup (describe -> apply -> read back, per app). libs:account's ProfileFragment draws them: selectTab(<page id>) opens one and onTabShown reports its SECTION (PAGE_SECTION), so the island never disagrees with the page.

account._doc: Cloud Account redesign, task 2 (a0_docs/eng-specs/cloud-account-redesign.md sections 2, 5, 6). Read by libs:account's build.gradle into BuildConfig.UI_ACCOUNT_B64 (ForgeClient.Decl). forges: where the vault lives, each written through its contents API; auth 'bearer' sends `Authorization: Bearer <t>` (GitHub), 'token' sends `Authorization: token <t>` (Gitea). A forge's token is read from AccountVault Connections at forge.<id>.token, the primary forge id at forge.primary (default: the first forge with a repo). vault: the branch, the folder the app writes per-device profiles to (devices/<id>.json, DEFAULT.json; never an emit.py input), and the generated secrets file the connect fetch keeps reading.

forges._doc_repo: null on purpose: the vault repo is NOT mirrored to Gitea (cloud-u-containers infra-dat_gitea build.json mirror_policy.exclude lists cloud-vault and cloud-me_vault), so no owner/repo path exists there. The owner declares it once a private Gitea repo for the vault exists; until then this forge is skipped (ForgeClient refuses a forge without a repo).
